examples.label: Example 1
examples.display:
events  = [[1, 50], [2, 5], [1, 0], [1, 8], [2, 40], [1, 58]]
timeout = 10
output  = [4, 8]

User 1 has times 0, 8, 50, 58: two sessions of length 8. User 2 has 5 and 40: two sessions of length 0.

examples.label: Example 2
examples.display:
events  = [[1, 0], [1, 5], [1, 10]]
timeout = 5
output  = [1, 10]

Gaps of exactly 5 do not split, so this is one session of length 10.
